about.label: About the Office
about.title: Experience, Integrity, Results
about.p1: With over 35 years of active legal practice, I have developed comprehensive expertise in multiple areas of law, successfully representing clients' interests in hundreds of complex cases.
about.p2: The office's philosophy is built on three fundamental pillars: rigorous preparation, a legal strategy tailored to each case, and transparent communication with the client throughout the representation.
about.p3: My approach combines deep knowledge of legislation with practical experience accumulated in courts at all levels, ensuring legal representation of the highest quality.

about.cred4: Member of the International Bar Association

approach.label: Methodology
approach.title: Our Approach
approach.description: A structured and methodical process ensuring optimal legal representation.
approach.step1Desc: Detailed assessment of the legal situation, identification of all relevant aspects and development of a personalised strategy tailored to each case.
approach.step2Desc: Formulating a strategic approach based on relevant case law, risk analysis and the client's objectives, ensuring the most efficient path to the desired outcome.
approach.step3Desc: Executing the strategy with attention to detail, compliance with procedural deadlines and maintaining professional standards at the highest level throughout the process.
approach.step4Desc: Constant updates on the case's progress, clear explanations of legal procedures and availability for clarifications and consultations throughout the engagement.

aboutPage.seoTitle: About Lawyer Cornaciu Cătălin | Cornaciu Law Office
aboutPage.seoDesc: Discover the story of lawyer Cornaciu Cătălin — over 35 years of legal experience in civil, commercial and criminal law.
aboutPage.label: About Me
aboutPage.title: Lawyer Cornaciu Cătălin
aboutPage.subtitle: Over 35 Years of Legal Excellence
aboutPage.bio1: I began my professional career as a lawyer in 1990, immediately after graduating from the Faculty of Law. Since then, I have been fully dedicated to legal practice, building a career founded on competence, integrity and concrete results.
aboutPage.bio2: Throughout over three decades of practice, I have successfully represented the interests of hundreds of clients — both individuals and legal entities — in cases of varying complexity, from civil and commercial litigation to major criminal proceedings.
aboutPage.bio3: My approach is based on rigorous analysis, a legal strategy tailored to each case, and transparent communication with the client. I believe every case deserves maximum attention and a personalised solution.
aboutPage.philosophy1: I firmly believe that the legal profession is not merely a career, but a vocation that demands responsibility towards every client and towards the justice system.
aboutPage.philosophy2: The principles guiding my work are: meticulous preparation, devotion to the client's interests, and adherence to the highest ethical and professional standards.
aboutPage.cred1: Member of the Giurgiu Bar since 1990
aboutPage.cred2: Certified in Mediation and Alternative Dispute Resolution
aboutPage.cred4: Member of the International Bar Association
